result.description: Fires on scattered word pieces early in a word or name, mainly LaTeX 'mathbf', 'dx', ' pid', and name starts like ' Mik' or ' Laur'. It looks like a first-layer mix of token detectors with no single shared meaning.
result.label: Scattered LaTeX and name-fragment tokens

result.description: Fires on the token piece 'ale' appearing as a word fragment (e.g. "aleph", "aleen", "kaleidoscope", "whale"). It is mostly a layer-0 token detector, with a self-named MLP latent and attention latent driving it.
result.label: 'ale' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token " Studies", mostly in title-like or field-name phrases (e.g. "Comparative Studies", "Studies in ..."). The contrast text lacks the token. Members include a " Studies" detector and many token-level pieces.
result.label: ' Studies' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token piece "cart" in "Descartes" (René Descartes), strongest after "Des" and weaker when "cart" starts a sentence. It stays silent on the misspelling "Kartes". Members are mostly "cart" detectors.
result.label: cart in Descartes

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' son' at the start of words like sonnet, sonar, sonority, sonorant, mostly in music, poetry or language text. It predicts continuations such as 'ic' or 'net'. A few weaker hits fall on related poetic or musical words.
result.label: ' son' word-start piece (sonnet, sonar)

result.description: Fires on word-initial fragments like ' Har' (Harvest, Harland), ' sur' (surplus, surge), ' har' and ' fle' that begin a longer word. Predicts continuation pieces; mostly a token-piece detector with several different prefixes.
result.label: Word-start prefixes Har/sur/fle

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' nucle' (nucleus, nucleic) and on ' cards' after "deck of". Layer-0 members detect nucle/nuc/card/dice tokens. The two peaks share little meaning beyond token identity, so it is a mixed token detector.
result.label: nucle- and cards token detector

result.description: Fires on the word-piece "ming" ending a word (Programming, overwhelming, warming, farming), and weakly on "ogy" endings. It appears to be a suffix detector for word-final pieces inside multi-token words.
result.label: Word-final 'ming' suffix piece

result.description: Layer-0 target firing on scattered tokens (apostrophe after a name, 'and', word fragments like 'ulse', 'ics', 'an') in academic text. Peaks are inconsistent and the members are mostly token-specific detectors; it likely predicts a word continuation such as Econom.
result.label: Scattered tokens in academic text

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ys' at the start of a word split into pieces (ys-regulated, ys-osomal, geophys-ical). It predicts word-completion suffixes like 'ical' and 'ics'. Weak on 'ys' in surveys.
result.label: 'ys' word-piece detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' extra', strongest when it begins a word like extravagant, extraction or extravagance, and more weakly when it is a standalone adjective ('extra food'). Members include ' extra' detectors and 'ction' detectors.
result.label: ' extra' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' icon' (as in iconic, iconography), mainly at the start of words like iconic/iconography. Driven by detectors for ' icon' itself; it boosts ' icon', ' icons' and ' Icon' as next tokens.
result.label: ' icon' token detector

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ful' (also 'fully') in "delightful", mainly after "delight". It stays silent on 'ful' in playful, successful and colourful. Members detect delight, pleasure and enjoy words plus 'ful' pieces.
result.label: 'ful' suffix in delightful

result.description: Fires on the word piece ' sch' at the start of scholar-type words (scholars, scholasticism). Members are mostly ' sch' token detectors; weaker on later positions in a passage.
result.label: ' sch' in scholar words

result.description: Fires on the word piece " scar" at the start of "scarce" or "scarcity", mostly in resource-allocation and economics text. It is silent on unrelated tokens in the contrast text.
result.label: ' scar' in scarce/scarcity

result.description: Fires on the word "database" and "databases" (weaker on "dataset" and "data") in technical text about database systems. Members are mostly detectors of database, data, system and similar computing words.
result.label: database token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'taire', the ending of "Voltaire", in mentions of the Enlightenment philosopher. Members include 'taire' token detectors plus Enlightenment context cues such as Renaissance, ideals, reform and monarch.
result.label: Voltaire 'taire' token

result.description: Fires on the final piece 'ude' (also 'udes') in "amplitude", after the 'plit' piece, in physics/signal text. Weaker on other mid-word pieces of technical words. Silent on the misspelled "amples".
result.label: 'ude' ending of amplitude
'core' token piece detector
result.description: Fires on the token 'core' (e.g. "-core", "multi-core", "hard-core", "unders|core"), mostly as a suffix piece attached to a prefix. Weak activation on a few verbs like traverse and navigate. Predicts word continuations.

result.label: -ruction suffix after reconst/Inst
result.description: Fires on the word piece 'ruction' completing words like "Reconstruction" and "Instruction", after a prefix piece such as 'reconst', 'Inst' or 'const'. Weaker on similar endings like '-itution'.

Fires on the word piece ' En' (space-prefixed), mostly at the start of words like Enlighted/Enlightenment. Weaker on ' En' in other words such as Entrench. Members are ' En' detectors plus an 'light/eden' piece detector.
result.label: ' En' word-start piece

result.description: Fires on the piece 'pos' when it sits inside a longer word such as pre-pos-itions, contra-pos-itive or com-pos-ition. It stays silent when 'pos' starts the word, as in 'positional'. It pushes towards continuations like 'itions'.
result.label: 'pos' inside prepositions/contrapositive

result.description: Fires on the suffix 'ness' when it follows "open" (openness, as in openness vs closedness). It stays silent on 'ness' after other stems like fair, compact, conscious and weak.
result.label: 'ness' in "openness"

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments such as 'ig' (pigment, enigmatic, Higgs), 'estr' (orchestration), 'onders' (wonders) and ' medic', where the word is unfinished. It pushes toward suffixes like 'ation' and 'ination'.
result.label: Word-fragment before -ation suffix

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'etic' (as in genetic, epigenetic) at the start of a document or passage, in science text about variation and populations. Driven mainly by token-specific 'etic' detectors in layer 0, plus suffix detectors like 'ology'.
result.label: 'etic' suffix token
Mixed word pieces: iac, uba, performance
result.description: Fires on a mix of unrelated tokens: the word piece 'iac' (cardiac), 'uba' (tuba), and ' performance'/' jazz'. Members are token detectors for these pieces plus music words. Evidence is mixed with no single shared condition.
Fires on the word piece 'ool' (as in wool, coolant, tooling) and on repeated '++' in dashed/plus separator lines. Mostly a layer-0 token-piece detector; weak on a few other word fragments.
result.label: 'ool' word piece and '++' runs

result.description: Fires on a few specific tokens, mainly ' accessible' (also after 'handicap' or 'more'), plus ' parsing' and ' Vienna'. Members are detectors of these individual tokens. Logits favour ' enough' and grammar-like continuations.
result.label: ' accessible' / ' parsing' / ' Vienna'

result.description: Fires on the token " interactions" (and " interaction"), mostly as a sentence-initial plural subject. Pushes next-token predictions toward "between" and "among". Members are mainly token detectors for interactions, plus a few related words such as relationships and structures.
result.label: ' interactions' token detector

result.description: Fires on the word piece " quad" at the start of "quadrilateral(s)", in geometry text. Members detect quad/ril pieces plus geometry words like angle, geomet, poly, verte.
result.label: ' quad' in quadrilateral

result.description: Fires on the word ' these' when it is followed by abstract plural nouns like concepts, funding streams, fundamentals. It is silent on ' these' in other spots, such as after verbs or 'how' and before 'elements/structures/variables'. The condition is unclear.
result.label: ' these' demonstrative (context-dependent)

result.description: Fires on the token ' sensitive' (occasionally ' drug'), in phrases like 'sensitive information', 'highly sensitive', 'culturally sensitive'. Silent on unrelated text such as the quantum cryptography contrast. Members detect sensitive/sensitivity-related tokens.
result.label: ' sensitive' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token "water", mostly as the end of a compound word (freshwater, wastewater, rainwater, groundwater). Members are mostly detectors of "water" and related pieces like rain and hydro. Silent on text without water.
result.label: water token, esp. in compounds

result.description: Fires on the word piece 'chn' in "-technology/-technical" words split as "ote|chn" (nanotechnology, biotechnology, geotechnical). It predicts a continuation like "ology".
result.label: 'chn' inside -technology words

result.description: Fires on mid-word fragments completing a multi-piece word, mainly 'ies' in royalt-ies and 'arm' in Sw-arm, also 'inn' and 'im'. Silent on 'ies' in 'colonies', so it depends on the specific word being completed.
result.label: Word-ending fragments: royalties, swarm

result.description: Fires on the token 'ray' as a word piece, mainly inside "portrayal(s)", also in "Brayton" and "X-ray". Layer-0 detectors of 'ray' drive it. The contrast has no 'ray' token, so no extra condition shows.
result.label: 'ray' piece in portrayal

result.description: Fires on the ending piece 'us' (or 'ian') of the name Columbus / Columbian, after the 'Columb' piece. It stays silent on 'us' elsewhere, such as in Gerardus or a standalone 'us'.
result.label: Columb-us name ending
"no longer" – ' longer' after "no"
result.description: Fires on ' longer' in the phrase "is no longer", where the previous token is "no". Members detect ' longer'/' long' and ' no' tokens. It is silent on unrelated text.

Layer-0 latent firing mostly on ' landscape', also ' society', 'Date', ' Cover', and similar scope or setting nouns (environment, world, horizon, scope). Members are token detectors for these nouns. Mixed, weak evidence of a shared context.
result.label: Landscape and society-type nouns

result.description: Fires on the word piece "ector" ending "detector" (smoke detector, edge detector). It needs the preceding "det" piece; the contrast with other word pieces is silent. Members are mostly detectors of "ector"-like endings.
result.label: "ector" in "detector"

result.description: Fires on a few unrelated tokens early in a word or phrase: " triple", " closed", and "ffect" (as in "Affective"). Members are detectors of triple/double, closed, and number words. Mixed evidence, no single clear condition.
result.label: triple / closed / ffect token detector

result.description: Fires on the word " immediate" as an adjective in many contexts (immediate response, immediate mode, almost immediate shift). Members include several detectors of " immediate" and near-synonyms like instant and swift.
result.label: ' immediate' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' work' in many uses (workplace, work environment, work-life, one's work). It boosts compound continuations like force, shop, place, load. Members are mostly ' work' detectors in layer 0.
result.label: ' work' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' conscious' (mostly as the start of "consciousness", also "conscious language"). Members detect ' conscious', 'ness', mind/mental/awareness words; it predicts continuations like 'ness'.
result.label: ' conscious' token detector

result.description: Fires on the token ' Alex' (the name, including as the start of Alexa/Alexa's), in every example. The contrast has no ' Alex', so no extra condition is evident. Members are mostly Alex-token detectors.
result.label: ' Alex' name token

result.description: Layer-0 latent firing on mid-word or word-ending pieces and varied tokens (aches, lies, ativity, sym, image) where a word is incomplete or being continued. No consistent token or meaning; peaks are scattered, and the circuit is a weak fit.
result.label: Scattered word-piece continuations

result.description: Fires on the token ' Element' (Elements, Finite Element, Elemental), mostly at the start of a title or heading-like phrase. Members include ' Element' token detectors and detectors of other word-start pieces. Silent on general math text without the word.
result.label: ' Element' token detector

result.description: Fires on scattered words in technical or scientific text, such as ' apparent', ' observable', ' angle', ' aware' and word pieces like 'ature'. These share a loose sense of perceivable or geometric properties. The peaks are mixed and consistency is low.
result.label: Scattered technical perceptual/geometric words

result.description: Fires on the standalone token 'de' as a separate word (e.g. 'de potentials', 'de the influence'), often at a prefix-like position. It stays silent when 'de' is inside a word such as Amadeus, ode or electrode.
result.label: standalone 'de' token

result.description: Fires on the word " as" in comparison and role constructions (as simple as, as good as, act as, seen as, as well as), including at document start. Pushes toward " well", "it", "merely", "simply". Silent on other text.
result.label: ' as' in comparisons and roles

result.description: Fires on the word piece "prop" (propagation, propelled, propulsion) and sometimes " fuel" or "erm" in geothermal, as a word-start fragment. Members are mostly "prop" token detectors plus unrelated fragment detectors.
result.label: "prop" word-start fragment
